info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Securities Fails Processing Review-spec
info.description: The Securities Fails Processing Review API allows financial institutions to submit reviews for securities failures within market operations. This endpoint facilitates the documentation and assessment of issues related to securities transactions, ensuring compliance and operational integrity. Typical consumers include risk management teams and compliance officers who need to review and address securities fails. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their review processes and enhance their operational responsiveness to market discrepancies.
